title: A non-trivial dynamics on the directed landscape
summary: We prove the existence of a non-trivial continuous stationary reversible dynamics on the directed landscape as a subsequential scaling limit of Brownian last passage percolation under the Ornstein--Uhlenbeck dynamics. Strong passage-time stability estimates from the companion paper Bhatia '26, together with static endpoint regularity, give tightness at the critical dynamical scale $n^{-1/3}$.
